subject: Creating a stanfit object without sampling

messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Creating a stanfit object without sampling
parts:
Hi all,

In rstan is there a simpler way to generate a stanfit object than to
do something like

my_stan_fit=sampling(my_stan_model, my_data, iter=1, chains=1)

I'm doing this to get a stan_fit object to pass to grad_log_prob.

Thanks in advance,

David.

--
David A. Knowles,
Stanford University.

In rstan is there a simpler way to generate a stanfit object than to
do something like

my_stan_fit=sampling(my_stan_model, my_data, iter=1, chains=1)

I'm doing this to get a stan_fit object to pass to grad_log_prob.

You can do iter = 0 or chains = 0, but you still have to compile it in order to subsequently use the grad_log_prob method for a stanfit object.

messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Re: Creating a stanfit object without sampling
parts:
I get errors specifying iter=0 or chains=0. In the end I just pulled some code out of optimizing. In case its of use to others: 

get_sampler=function(object, data) {
  rstan:::prep_call_sampler(object)
  model_cppname <- object@model_cpp$model_cppname 
  mod <- get("module", envir = object@dso@.CXXDSOMISC, inherits = FALSE) 
  stan_fit_cpp_module <- eval(call("$", mod, paste('stan_fit4', model_cppname, sep = '')))
  stopifnot(is.list(data))
  parsed_data <- rstan:::parse_data(get_cppcode(object))
  for (i in seq_along(data)) parsed_data[[names(data)[i]]] <- data[[i]]
  parsed_data <- parsed_data[!sapply(parsed_data, is.null)]
  new(stan_fit_cpp_module, parsed_data, object@dso@.CXXDSOMISC$cxxfun)
} 

Then I can just do

sampler <- get_sampler( my_stan_model, data )
sampler$grad_log_prob( theta, T )

Thanks for your help anyway.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Creating a stanfit object without sampling
parts:
Yeah this will not be an issue in the future given the impending rstan redesign. The plan is to start work on that soon, so I'm not sure it makes sense to add anything temporary to rstan now. In the meantime setting iter=0 results in error or warning messages but you should still get back a valid stanfit object with no posterior draws.

Jonah
